meaning: to become sick, to fall ill

example.romanization: Kì sâng-phiang, oi hi khon yî-sên.
example.english: He's sick, he needs to go see a doctor.

note: 生病 works as a whole verb phrase (not 'to give birth to sickness') — you can also just say 病 alone, as in 佢病忒了 (he's gotten sick), where 忒 marks a completed change of state.
